reasoning: The first set of measurements revealed that one transformer pad (near Building 7/6) is only 5.2 feet from Building 7, which is marginal to the 5-foot requirement. Additionally, several transformer pads appear to be located adjacent to or very close to drive aisles (parking/vehicle routes). Per UCM § 1.10.4, if a transformer pad is within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes, it requires 4-inch diameter galvanized bollards. I need to measure: (1) distance from each transformer pad to the nearest edge of the drive aisle curb/pavement, (2) verify the hot-stick access clearance to open area (minimum 10 feet), and (3) check proximity to fire hydrants (5-foot minimum per reviewer convention).
